name: Shiro
source:
Likes: I love Yuki!
Favorite things: I love to play with Yuki and when he strokes my head.
Hobbies: Taking walks.
Strong points: House guarding! (She's lying! (by Yuki))
Dislikes: Green onions!!
Dogs or Cats? ⇒ I'm a dog, so...

A cute girl that claims to be Yuki's deceased dog from 10 years ago. An innocent and friendly person who enjoys Yuki's smile the most in the world. 

[Partially translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=750613]Getchu[/url]]
